title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 12 - August #125 Aardvark-Vanaheim 1989 Dave Sim Comic
descriptionText: This is the 12th issue of Cerebus: Jaka's Story, published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in August 1989. The comic was written and illustrated by Dave Sim, a renowned artist and writer in the US comics tradition. The issue features the character Cerebus, a giant turtle who serves as the narrator and protagonist of the series. This issue is a must-have for fans of the comics genre and collectors of vintage comics.
